events.text: WBSTEP7 materials source completed; resolving with source commit next.
materials/skins unification landed (materials source 5a38b578c); user-confirmed downstream

resolution: WBSTEP7 makes MATERIAL the authored material door: shader recipes, stored game materials, React textures, and decals are unified in the workbench material source, while PAINT remains the one agnostic painter and material targets route back through that stored-material door. Downstream consumers now mount the material-owned chooser contract instead of growing parallel texture paths. Source commit: 5a38b578c.
